info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Actions Management API
info.description: The Operational Actions Management API enables businesses to streamline and automate the handling of site operations within their banking facilities. This API facilitates the initiation of key operational actions that are essential for maintaining efficient site functionality. Typical consumers include banking institutions and operational managers who require programmatic access to manage and execute actions related to site operations. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their operational workflows and ensure better resource management across their facilities.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for site operations.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new operational action associated with site operations. The operational action will be processed and stored in the system, enabling efficient site management and operational oversight.
